oracle_observation: Short recommendation: each morning pick 1–3 clear, testable tasks and work in focused sprints (25–50 minutes) with notifications off; commit often, run tests/CI before major merges, and keep PRs small to simplify reviews. Caveats: strict timeboxing can interrupt deep problem-solving—extend a sprint if you’re in flow—and never skip code reviews or tests to “move faster,” as that increases bugs and technical debt.
